rating.comments: Reasoning: the student gave bare values such as "200" and "1L", and the message "there is 200 students, one student use 1L of water every day, there are 300 days" lists inputs without justification. Knowledge building: they restated their own earlier numbers and answered "yes" to the five-day week, but the "300 days" figure was not revised after the AI's weekly correction. Question asking: the opening question "How much water in litres do students consume at our school each week?" is relevant to the task. Effort: after supplying inputs, they pushed the calculation back with "no please do it", which is low effort.
